messages:
maria.ordonez: Hi team — auditor followed up asking for a 'timestamped proof' bundle for last month's privilege review. They want to see role reductions, who approved, and an immutable proof of the export. What artifacts should we provide?
ryan.devops: We have the RBAC change PRs, deploy traces, and cloud audit logs. Clarify: by 'timestamped proof' do they mean a signed snapshot or just logs with a clear chain-of-custody?
auditor_klein: Prefer immutable proof: signed KMS audit/export + git commit SHAs for IaC changes, plus a simple chain-of-custody (requestor, approver, timestamp). If you can publish a hash to a tamper-evident log, even better.
maria.ordonez: OK. We can bundle k8s RBAC manifests (from git), GitHub PR approval records, and CloudTrail/Cloud Audit logs. @sec_bot can you advise on how to export KMS audit events?
sec_bot: SecBot: To export KMS key access logs I need: exact key ARN(s), time window, and destination S3 bucket for signed export. Note exports show envelope metadata, not plaintext keys. I'll kick off the job once you provide details.
jason-l: Also include CI/CD workflow IDs and runner hostnames so auditor can tie deploys to commits.
eva: For separation-of-duties evidence they specifically want proof the approver != requestor. Include PR author, approvers list, and approval timestamps (screenshots OK).
ryan.devops: I'll collate PR URLs, git SHAs, CI run IDs, manifest diffs, and CloudTrail events for iam:* changes. That cover it?
auditor_klein: Yes, plus: a security attestation document (signed by someone in Sec) and a hash of the bundle published to a timestamping service (RFC3161 or sigstore). If logs are older than retention, include the retention policy and any exception approvals.
maria.ordonez: Quick Q on emergency overrides: we have a 'breakglass' flow where SRE escalates and we rotate creds. Auditor wants proof the rotation happened and the trigger. What artifacts do we have?
ryan.devops: Incident ticket with timeline, rotation run logs, PagerDuty escalation entries, and KMS rotation events. Note: some rotation events live in a different cloud account — will need cross-account mapping.
sec_bot: SecBot: Reminder to redact PII in ticket text and replace with hashed IDs in the manifest. Also ensure S3 export is encrypted and access-restricted.
maria.ordonez: Draft plan: 1) collate GitHub PRs + SHAs, 2) export CloudTrail/KMS slices, 3) gather CI/CD run logs, 4) assemble incident tickets for overrides, 5) produce security attestation PDF and sign it. Assigning: @ryan.devops = logs & CloudTrail, @jason-l = CI/deploy IDs, @eva = PR approvals, @sec_bot = KMS export.
jason-l: On it — CI IDs by EOD.
ryan.devops: CloudTrail slices ETA tomorrow morning — may need retention approval for >90d.
auditor_klein: If retention prevents export, provide the documented policy + exception request + approval evidence. That usually satisfies audit.
maria.ordonez: Auditor also asked for a 'signed snapshot' of IAM state at a point-in-time. We can take terraform state at the commit SHA and sign it. Security signature required?
eva: Yes, security needs to sign the snapshot.
maria.ordonez: Great. I'll create an evidence manifest and upload initial bundle to S3. Filing ticket SEC-482 to track.
sec_bot: SecBot: Export job created SEC-482-KMS-EXPORT, waiting on key ARN list. Ping @ryan.devops with ARNs.
auditor_klein: If possible, timestamp the S3 upload with an external RFC3161 timestamp or publish the bundle hash to a timestamping log — auditor will mark that up as preferred.
maria.ordonez: Good call. I'll request RFC3161 timestamping on upload and update thread with S3 link once uploaded.
